description: This file defines the CreateRoleCommandHandler class, which handles the creation of roles within the user administration module of the Fineract system. It implements command processing for role creation, leveraging the RoleWritePlatformService.

classes.name: CreateRoleCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class responsible for handling commands to create new roles within the system. It processes incoming commands and delegates the creation logic to the RoleWritePlatformService.

methods.name: CreateRoleCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the RoleWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command for creating a role and delegates the operation to the write platform service.
